title: Lazy Initialization with OnceCell
goal: Initialize a cached slice on demand using OnceCell.
hints: `OnceCell::get_or_init` takes an initialization closure that runs only if the cell is empty.
The closure must return the inner type Vec<u8> directly.
explanation: `OnceCell::get_or_init` initializes the cell on first access using the closure and returns `&Vec<u8>`, which derefs to `&[u8]`. Plain `get()` does not take an initialization closure (`E0061`). Returning `Some(...)` or `&[...]` violates the expected return type `Vec<u8>` for the initialization closure (`E0308`).
